Author: rtimothyedwards_19428
Content: @namibj :  We did flip-chip in the early days of the Efabless open MPW runs, and the problem that we had was that (1) it was ridiculously expensive, and (2) it took a ridiculously long time to get done.  Eventually we switched to wirebonding because it was just easier, quicker, and cheaper all around.  Also I ended up with a padframe design that was good for flip-chip but suboptimal for wirebonding and we were stuck with that solution, which is still being used for wirebond packages. . .   Other than that, the flip-chip solution was great!  If you can figure out how to overcome the cost and delay issues, then it is definitely worth having.
